```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 */6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: airbyte

      - name: Checkout airbyte-agent-connectors
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          path: airbyte-agent-connectors

      - name: Copy AI connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p airbyte/docs/ai-agents/connectors
          find airbyte-agent-connectors/connectors -type f -name "*.md" -exec cp {} airbyte/docs/ai-agents/connectors/ \;

      - name: Clean up airbyte-agent-connectors checkout
        run: |
          rm -rf airbyte-agent-connectors

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          path: airbyte
          commit-message: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          title: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          body: "Automated sync of AI connector documentation from airbyte-agent-connectors"
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
          team-reviewers: |
            airbyte-platform/airbyte-platform

      - name: Enable Auto-Merge
        uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          pull-request-number: ${{ steps.create-pr.outputs.pull-request-number }}
          merge-method: MERGE
```
